title: Integrated network pharmacology and molecular docking based insights into transient receptor potential melastatin3 regulatory mechanism in COPD.
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究TRPM3激动剂在COPD中的靶点，虽含分子对接但对象为离子通道-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a multifactorial airway disorder characterized by chronic inflammation, epithelial dysfunction, and dysregulated intracellular signaling. Transient receptor potential melastatin 3 (TRPM3), a Ca(2)(+) permeable ion channel has emerged as a potential regulator of inflammatory and survival pathways, however, its therapeutic relevance in COPD remains poorly understood. The present study integrates network pharmacology and molecular docking to identify putative targets of TRPM3 agonists CIM0216, pregnenolone sulfate (preg sulfate), and nifedipine in COPD. A total of 2442 unique COPD associated genes were identified and integrated with predicted TRPM3 agonist targets revealing 20, 28, and 38 common targets for CIM0216, preg sulfate, and nifedipine, respectively. Enrichment analyses highlighted EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance and PI3K/AKT signaling as key COPD related pathways which also correlated with major TFs. Further, AKT1, JAK2, and PTGS2 were identified as central hub genes, particularly associated with CIM0216 and nifedipine. No common hub genes were identified among all three TRPM3 agonists, nor between the CIM0216-preg sulfate and nifedipine-preg sulfate combinations. The hub genes were validated through GEO dataset (GSE57148). The identified miRNAs form a dense regulatory network controlling inflammatory, proliferative, and immune signaling pathways through key transcription factors, underscoring the importance of miRNA-mediated regulation in COPD progression. Molecular docking revealed that CIM0216 exhibited strong binding affinity towards TRPM3 (DeltaG =  - 8.6 kcal/mol with 3 hydrogen bonds), AKT1 (DeltaG =  - 10.8 kcal/mol with 4 hydrogen bonds), JAK2 (DeltaG =  - 9.0 kcal/mol with 4 hydrogen bonds), and PTGS2 (DeltaG =  - 9.7 kcal/mol with 6 hydrogen bonds) as compared with nifedipine which showed moderate affinity towards TRPM3 (DeltaG =  - 7.1 kcal/mol and 6 hydrogen bonds), AKT1 (DeltaG =  - 7.3 kcal/mol and 3 hydrogen bonds), JAK2 (DeltaG =  - 6.4 kcal/mol and 2 hydrogen bonds), and PTGS2 (DeltaG =  - 7.6 kcal/mol and 11 hydrogen bonds), supporting its potential for effective modulation of COPD associated signaling pathways. The study predicts that CIM0216 might act as a potential multi-target agonist of key inflammatory and survival pathways implicated in COPD. The findings propose a mechanistic insight into TRPM3-mediated signaling and support further experimental validation of TRPM3 agonists as novel therapeutic candidates for COPD. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s40203-026-00707-3.
abstract_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）是一种多因素气道疾病，其特征为慢性炎症、上皮功能障碍及细胞内信号传导失调。瞬时受体电位通道melastatin 3（TRPM3）作为一种Ca(2)(+)通透性离子通道，已被认为是炎症和存活通路的潜在调节因子，然而其在COPD中的治疗相关性仍知之甚少。本研究整合网络药理学和分子对接技术，以识别TRPM3激动剂CIM0216、孕烯醇酮硫酸酯（preg sulfate）和硝苯地平在COPD中的推定靶点。共鉴定出2442个独特的COPD相关基因，并与预测的TRPM3激动剂靶点整合，分别揭示出CIM0216、preg sulfate和硝苯地平的20、28和38个共同靶点。富集分析强调EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂耐药性和PI3K/AKT信号通路为关键的COPD相关通路，这些通路也与主要转录因子相关。此外，AKT1、JAK2和PTGS2被鉴定为核心枢纽基因，尤其与CIM0216和硝苯地平相关。在所有三种TRPM3激动剂之间，以及CIM0216-preg sulfate和硝苯地平-preg sulfate组合之间，均未鉴定出共同枢纽基因。枢纽基因通过GEO数据集（GSE57148）得到验证。所鉴定的miRNA形成密集的调控网络，通过关键转录因子控制炎症、增殖和免疫信号通路，强调了miRNA介导的调控在COPD进展中的重要性。分子对接显示，与硝苯地平相比，CIM0216对TRPM3（DeltaG = -8.6 kcal/mol，含3个氢键）、AKT1（DeltaG = -10.8 kcal/mol，含4个氢键）、JAK2（DeltaG = -9.0 kcal/mol，含4个氢键）和PTGS2（DeltaG = -9.7 kcal/mol，含6个氢键）表现出强结合亲和力，而硝苯地平对TRPM3（DeltaG = -7.1 kcal/mol，含6个氢键）、AKT1（DeltaG = -7.3 kcal/mol，含3个氢键）、JAK2（DeltaG = -6.4 kcal/mol，含2个氢键）和PTGS2（DeltaG = -7.6 kcal/mol，含11个氢键）表现出中等亲和力，支持其有效调节COPD相关信号通路的潜力。本研究预测CIM0216可能作为COPD中关键炎症和存活通路的多靶点激动剂。研究结果为TRPM3介导的信号传导提供了机制性见解，并支持对TRPM3激动剂作为COPD新型治疗候选药物进行进一步实验验证。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s40203-026-00707-3获取。
